name: unverified_0x452E25 unauthenticated uniswapV3SwapCallback
summary: An unverified MEV bot contract implements uniswapV3SwapCallback without checking that the caller is a pool it called, and pays the token and amount encoded in the callback data to msg.sender. The attacker called the callback directly to have the bot transfer its WETH.
notes: The direct runtime containing the callback defect was installed by this top-level contract creation; the deployer created no other contract and no Etherscan label names the operator.
Three later direct callback calls from two other senders took small WETH remainders and are listed as campaign; loss covers all four.
